entries.input: Colour every point of the plane red or green so that for any three non-collinear points of one colour, the centre of the circle through them has that colour too. Prove that every point then has the same colour.
entries.name: Putnam2025B1
entries.binders: (c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Bool) (h : ∀ A B C P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), c A = c B → c B = c C → ¬ Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) → dist P A = dist P B → dist P B = dist P C → c P = c A)
entries.conclusion: ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), c x = c y
entries.title: Putnam 2025 B1
